text: BAM's share of Solana stake eased to 38.0% (165.2M SOL) over the past 28 hours. Just 3 of the 17 live nodes hold a majority of marketplace stake, with the largest at 23.1% and 90 validators concentrated on the busiest node in fra. The top node by stake changed hands 69 times in this window — whale-driven routing, not structural rollovers.
